notes: SPRINT-24 adoption, full scope in one sprint (docs/LANGUAGES.md Scala section): all eleven passes enabled -- the TENTH full-scope pack, wave-3 continues. The pinned tree-sitter/tree-sitter-scala v0.23.4 grammar (the MAIN tree-sitter org's grammar) is byte-verified against the npm binding package tree-sitter-scala@0.23.4 for parser.c/scanner.c/node-types.json/grammar.json/LICENSE; the 0.24.0 npm twin was regenerated from a DIFFERENT commit than the v0.24.0 git tag (20285 vs 19568 parser states), so the pin stays at 0.23.4 -- recorded at the vendor line. LANGUAGE_VERSION 14, accepted by the vendored runtime v0.27.2. The external scanner (src/scanner.c: the significant-indentation outdent tokens, string-interpolation delimiters) is picked up by oc_add_grammar automatically and was audited CLEAN at adoption against the Swift lessons: ts_calloc(1, ...) (not calloc(0)), no bit shifts, bounded serialize/deserialize -- no sanitizer carve-out. Symbols: function_definition (by construction a def WITH a body -- free functions, methods, extension/given-body methods, nested and generic defs); the bodyless function_declaration (trait/abstract members) is NOT a symbol (the C prototype discipline, Kotlin took the same boundary). Lambdas are anonymous constructs: NOT symbols, decisions count inward. Parameters: the parameter node carries name/type/default_value FIELDS (unlike Kotlin's field-less shape); a variadic type (repeated_parameter_type) collapses to the '...' marker, the Kotlin vararg discipline; implicit/using modifiers are anonymous tokens and invisible to the extractor. Decision table: if_expression (else-if nested; Scala's if is both statement and ternary -- ONE kind), case_clause (EVERY match/catch arm counts including the wildcard arm -- the Rust match_arm discipline; the catch's case_block arms cover the catch decision so there is NO separate catch kind -- counting both would double-count every caught arm), for_expression, while_expression, do_while_expression, and infix_expression gated in C to the boolean operators && / || ONLY (the operator is a NAMED operator_identifier, the shared anonymous-token ops mechanism cannot express it -- the Java switch-group family-special-case pattern; every other infix operator is not a decision). 'match' itself is not a kind (its arms are); Scala 3 indented match arms still parse as case_clause; enum cases (simple_enum_case) are not decisions. Resolver v1-scala: the DECLARED-FACT resolver, SHARED implementation with v1-kotlin -- Scala's package model is decoupled from the file system (no package==directory rule, none is invented), so every specifier resolves against the RECORDED package_clause facts (the Go package_clause hint channel; the FIRST clause, the chained-package boundary) and top-level declaration names (the C# namespace-hint channel, fed by the exports loop) of the analyzed set; wildcard 'a.b.*' fans out over the package's files (the Java asterisk-marker precedent), single 'a.b.C' requires the declared symbol (the union fans out over every file that carries it -- set semantics, lexicographic order), member 'a.b.C.f' matches BOTH declared-fact readings. Import shapes: wildcard (BOTH the Scala 2 '_' and the Scala 3 '*' spellings parse to the same namespace_wildcard node -- probed), selector groups ({A, B} -> one record per selector, the Rust use-tree expansion precedent), renames ('as' and '=>' both -- the alias is local surface detail, the ORIGINAL name is bound, never a narrowing predicate), plain 'a.b.C' binds the LAST segment for one/two-segment paths and keeps NULL for three or more (the AMBIGUOUS MEMBER shape: binding 'f' would under-mark the object 'C' the member reading actually uses -- whole-file claim, the C++ include discipline). Without hints every specifier stays unresolved (the honest degradation). The imports relation is a SET. NO mate marking (the C/C++ precedent; link order is not a parse fact). OC005 marking: wildcard and NULL-bind claims mark whole files (fail-open); named claims mark the matching export. Entry points: EMPTY manifest list BY DESIGN -- the entry claim is the PARSE FACT of (a) a function_definition named main with a parameters list inside an object_definition (the JVM entry shape; the object need not be top-level -- the honest over-claim direction, the C #ifdef note, OC006 severity INFO) or (b) an @main-annotated function_definition (the Scala 3 spelling). Test conventions: none registered in v1 (no runner-executed Scala convention is name-pinned). OC007 fires with a Cobertura-shaped XML via --coverage (sbt-jacoco emits JaCoCo-compatible XML; the JaCoCo reader is the Java pack's -- the same honesty applies: nothing is invented for a format the reader does not take). Supply tier (the honest delineation): the Scala pack has NO canonical dependency manifest reader in v1 -- build.sbt is executable DSL code (a libraryDependencies++ call is not a version-pinned artifact and is not read), no sbt lockfile is universally present, and no OSV Scala ecosystem exists; OC009/OC010 are enabled pack data that never discover anything Scala-specific: the SCALA pack contributes zero manifest rows on any scan; on a Scala-only scan the supply block is ABSENT (on a mixed scan the block may carry the OTHER packs' tiers -- the Java Maven reader on a pom.xml tree -- while the Scala contribution stays zero). Metaprogramming (macros, implicits/givens resolution, type classes, compiler plugins) is a parse fact only as far as the grammar sees it -- the Rust macro boundary, accepted in the over-report direction for OC006. As-written analysis: no build-system evaluation; sbt/Maven/Gradle variants are reported as the single parsed configuration. The pinned grammar's known boundaries (measured and classified at the corpus gate): chained packages record the OUTER clause only; Scala 3 '-source:future' syntax (fewer braces beyond the indented shapes probed) may fall to error nodes and is reported honestly as parse errors; given/extension definitions are container shapes, not symbols.

SPRINT-20 adoption, full scope in one sprint (docs/LANGUAGES.md C section): all eleven passes enabled -- the SIXTH full-scope pack. The pinned tree-sitter-c v0.23.4 grammar ships NO external scanner (src/ holds parser.c, grammar.json, node-types.json only). Symbols: function DEFINITIONS with a body (the whole definition is the span); the grammar has no name field, so the symbol name is the identifier at the bottom of the declarator chain (plain, pointer-return, parenthesized and function-pointer-return shapes; resolved by descending declarator fields, never guessed). Prototypes are NOT symbols -- the definition normally exists in the same analysis root and counting both would double every function and give OC007 two anchors per name; the header API surface is the exports query's job. Decision table: if_statement (else-if is a NESTED if_statement, so each branch increments by itself) + while/do/for + case_statement WITH a value field (a default arm is the same node type WITHOUT the value and counts 0, the gocyclo discipline; fall-through case labels are separate nodes) + the ternary conditional_expression, plus && and || inside the shared binary_expression container. Preprocessor conditionals (#if/#ifdef/#elif) are NOT decisions -- they select code at COMPILE time and the analysis runs on raw source. Resolver v1-c: the include channel -- quoted includes resolve against the INCLUDING file's directory (the C preprocessor's own rule, lexical .. pops, the PHP include-channel discipline); angle-bracket system includes NEVER resolve (recorded-and-unresolved, the Go module-boundary precedent -- the dependency signal stays visible without a manifest tier); a macro path (#include HEADER) records NOTHING (not a static payload); the imports relation is a SET. NO mate marking (link order is not a parse fact). OC005 marking: an include binds NULL -- a whole-file claim (the Ruby require discipline). Entry points: NO name-glob convention -- the entry claim is the PARSE FACT of a function DEFINITION named main (the Q_C_MAIN fact, the Go package-main class; a main behind an #ifdef wrapper still claims, the honest over-claim direction, OC006 severity is INFO); entry_points is empty because no basename glob can express 'defines main'. .h files belong to this pack while C++ is not registered -- the KNOWN FUTURE BOUNDARY: when the cpp pack registers, .h routing gets the content-sniff + project-root-default treatment written into the report (the approved C/C++ architecture decision); until then every .h is C. Test conventions: none registered in v1 (no runner-executed C convention is name-pinned; a *_test.c name claims nothing). OC007 fires with a Cobertura-shaped XML via --coverage; gcovr emits Cobertura XML natively (class filename= records + line number=/hits=), so a gcovr report works through the existing reader; lcov tracefiles (.info) are out of scope in v1 and would be rejected as unrecognized. Supply tier (the honest delineation, SPRINT-20): C has NO canonical dependency manifest -- OC009 and OC010 are enabled pack data but there is no C manifest reader, so nothing is ever discovered for them (no fabricated pkg-config/vendored tier: a versionless include is not a pin and a vendored tree is not a manifest); without their inputs the passes produce nothing and the report meta says so (manifests_scanned: 0). No OSV ecosystem exists for C includes and none is invented. OC010's licence-file probe (LICENSE/COPYING basenames) is a manifest-reader convention and is likewise deferred with the same rationale. Metaprogramming (X-macros, token pasting, macro-generated declarations) is not a parse fact -- the Rust macro boundary, accepted in the over-report direction for OC006. As-written analysis: no preprocessing is performed; conditional-compilation variants are reported as the single parsed configuration.

SPRINT-23 adoption, full scope in one sprint (docs/LANGUAGES.md Swift section): all eleven passes enabled -- the NINTH full-scope pack, wave-3 continues. The pinned alex-pinkus/tree-sitter-swift 0.7.1-with-generated-files grammar (the CANONICAL Swift grammar: the tree-sitter org's tree-sitter-swift is an abandoned unrelated project whose own README redirects here, and every npm tree-sitter-swift version publishes from alex-pinkus; the tag carries NO v prefix) is byte-verified against the npm binding package tree-sitter-swift@0.7.1 for parser.c/scanner.c/node-types.json/grammar.json/LICENSE. LANGUAGE_VERSION 14, accepted by the vendored runtime (ABI window 13..15). The external scanner (src/scanner.c: block comments, raw string parts, implicit/explicit semicolons, the &&/||/?? operator tokens, the #if directive tokens) is picked up by oc_add_grammar automatically. Symbols: function_declaration WITH its function_body field -- free functions, methods, extension methods (the receiver is the extension declaration, not part of the function), static/class methods, nested and generic functions; init_declaration/deinit_declaration with a body ARE symbols named init/deinit (the C# constructor precedent; the grammar gives init no readable name node so the C side synthesizes the spellings); a protocol_function_declaration WITH a default body is a symbol (the pinned grammar wraps the default body in a nested protocol_function_declaration node -- the C# interface-default precedent, a body carries decisions that would otherwise count toward nothing); body-less protocol REQUIREMENTS are NOT symbols (the C prototype discipline). Lambdas (lambda_literal) are anonymous constructs: NOT symbols, decisions count inward. Property accessor bodies ARE symbols (the C# SPRINT-14 accounting-hole precedent): computed_getter/computed_setter AND the implicit getter (statements directly in the computed_property) surface as Prop.get/Prop.set, the observers as Prop.willSet/Prop.didSet -- the owner is a PARENT CLIMB (the accessors nest INSIDE the property_declaration, unlike Kotlin's sibling walk); an accessor with no statements (an empty didSet {}) never matches. Parameters: the parameter node HAS fields -- name = the name field (an external argument label rides external_name and stays out of the name), type = the named child after the ':' token (the generated parser labels the TYPE with the name field too -- a quirk the probe caught; the extraction is positional), default = the default_value field INSIDE the node; a trailing anonymous '...' child collapses the variadic to the '...' marker (the C++ convention). Decision table: if_statement (else-if nested), guard_statement, ternary_expression (the C# conditional_expression precedent), switch_entry (EVERY arm counts including the default arm -- the Rust match_arm discipline), for_statement, while_statement, repeat_while_statement (Swift's do-while), catch_block, nil_coalescing_expression (the C# '??' op precedent as its own node kind -- the Kotlin elvis_expression precedent) and the two boolean containers conjunction_expression/disjunction_expression (Swift has NO shared binary_expression; as kinds each named node counts once per occurrence -- identical semantics). '#if' compilation directives are NOT a decision kind (the C/C++/C# packs count no preprocessor conditional). Resolver v1-swift: the DECLARED-FACT resolver, the MODULE spelling -- Swift's import specifier names a compilation TARGET, a fact no source file carries, so resolution keys on the MANIFEST-declared facts: every analyzed Package.swift contributes (target name, declared path) pairs through the target-hint channel (the manifest filename is SPM's own fixed convention, not a heuristic; the extraction reads the .target/.executableTarget/.testTarget calls' name: and path: string literals, nothing else); each analyzed file joins its module by the DECLARED path (an explicit path: as written, else the SPM documented default Sources/<name> -- the same class of build-system rule as the javac package==directory mapping); files outside every declared target stay module-less and are never import targets. Import shapes: 'M' (whole-module), 'M.Sub' (submodule -- the FIRST segment is the module, the refine is a recorded v1 boundary) and kind-scoped 'import kind M.T' bind the LAST segment as a named member claim (the over-mark direction bounded by the declared facts); everything else binds NULL = the wholesale fail-open claim (importing a module loads all of it, the Kotlin wildcard discipline). The pinned grammar has NO import-alias shape (probed boundary: 'import struct Kit.Tag as T' does not parse -- recorded, never guessed). Without hints every specifier stays unresolved (the honest degradation). The imports relation is a SET. OC005 marking: NULL-bind claims mark whole files (fail-open); kind-scoped member claims mark the matching export. Entry points: EMPTY manifest list BY DESIGN -- the entry claim is the PARSE FACT of top-level code (the Q_SW_TOP fact: Swift's spec lets exactly one file per module carry top-level statements -- the C# 9 global-statement precedent; a top-level let is a DECLARATION and never fires it). Test conventions: none registered in v1 (no runner-executed Swift convention is name-pinned). OC007 fires with a Cobertura-shaped XML via --coverage. Supply tier (the honest delineation): the Swift pack has NO canonical dependency manifest reader in v1 -- Package.resolved IS a version-pinned artifact but no OSV Swift ecosystem exists and none is invented, so OC009/OC010 are enabled pack data that never discover anything: the SWIFT pack contributes zero manifest rows on any scan; on a Swift-only scan the supply block is ABSENT (on a mixed scan the block may carry the OTHER packs' tiers while the Swift contribution stays zero). Metaprogramming (macros, property wrappers, result builders, #if evaluation) is a parse fact only as far as the grammar sees it -- the Rust macro boundary, accepted in the over-report direction for OC006. As-written analysis: no build-system evaluation beyond the manifest's declared target table; swift-tools-version gating is not evaluated. The pinned grammar's known boundaries (measured and classified at the corpus gate): import aliases do not parse ('import struct Kit.Tag as T'); newer Swift syntax (macros, if/switch expressions) may fall to error nodes and is reported honestly as parse errors.

SPRINT-16 adoption, full scope in one sprint (docs/LANGUAGES.md Ruby section): all eleven passes enabled -- the fourth full-scope pack. Symbols: method + singleton_method (endless defs are the same node); empty methods are symbols with complexity exactly 1 (the Java discipline); blocks never are (inclusive counting). Decision table: if/unless/while/until/for + when (one per clause) + in_clause (one per clause; if_guard does not count separately) + rescue + the five postfix modifier forms + the ternary, plus &&/||/and/or inside binary (the descriptor names its ops container: the Ruby node is `binary`; the shared walker matches kinds on NAMED nodes only -- the Ruby keyword tokens share type strings with their constructs). Resolver v1-ruby: require_relative resolves against the requiring file's directory (.rb appended); bare require probes the two documented load-root conventions under the analysis root (<root>/p.rb, then <root>/lib/p.rb -- the gemspec/bundler layout); $LOAD_PATH is never read from any manifest; the imports relation is a SET. OC005 marking: a require binds NULL -- a whole-file claim (requiring loads all top-level constants); NO same-directory mate marking (Ruby's global-constant visibility is decided at runtime load order; over-report is the accepted direction). Entry points: the pack globs (bin/*, exe/* -- the bundler executable conventions) plus the pre-existing shebang hint (#! is a comment to the Ruby parser, so a #! first line is ALWAYS a kernel shebang). Test conventions: the runner-collected NAME conventions test_*.rb / *_test.rb / *_spec.rb (minitest/RSpec) -- name-based only, no directory claiming. OC007 fires only with a SimpleCov .resultset.json profile passed via --coverage (lines array positional: index i is line i+1, numeric entries are anchors, covered when > 0; null entries are not-relevant and NOT anchors); OC009 only with a vendored OSV snapshot (ecosystem rubygems) via --osv-snapshot; OC010 checks the Gemfile/Gemfile.lock licence layering (no licence field -- the project-root licence-FILE probe, the go.mod discipline). Manifests: Gemfile (bounded single-line gem-call reader; bare-version and = specs are pins, comparator ranges are NOT -- bundler's own semantics; path: options are in-repo links, not OC009 material) and Gemfile.lock (GEM>specs 4-space entries are the resolved pins; 6-space sub-entries and GIT/PATH sections record nothing). .gemspec files are not read in v1 (the DSL's evaluation semantics exceed a bounded reader). Metaprogramming (define_method/attr_accessor/eval) generates methods at runtime -- not parse facts (the Rust macro boundary's analogue). Without their inputs OC007/OC009/OC010 produce nothing and the report meta says so. Passes are pack data, zero tool-code change to flip.

SPRINT-19 adoption, full scope in one sprint (docs/LANGUAGES.md PHP section): all eleven passes enabled -- the FIFTH full-scope pack. The MIXED php+html grammar (php/src/) is the one compiled: HTML-mixed template files parse with text/text_interpolation nodes that are inert to every analysis; one descriptor handles both file kinds. Symbols: function_definition + method_declaration with a real body; EMPTY methods (interface signatures, abstract) are symbols with complexity exactly 1 (the Java bodyless-slot discipline); anonymous_function/arrow_function/anonymous_class never are (the Ruby blocks precedent -- their decisions count inward, inclusive). Decision table: if_statement (elseif is its own else_if_clause) + while/do/for/foreach + case_statement (one per clause; a default arm is the DISTINCT default_statement and counts 0 -- the gocyclo discipline) + match arms (one per match_conditional_expression arm, comma condition lists are ONE arm -- the Ruby when-clause discipline; the match_default_expression arm IS an arm) + catch_clause + conditional_expression (full and short ternary are the SAME node), plus &&/||/and/or inside the shared binary_expression container (cx_ops_node stays NULL). ?? is a value operator, not a branch. Resolver v1-php: use declarations resolve through the composer.json PSR-4/PSR-0 mapping read from the ANALYSIS ROOT (longest-prefix rule, backslash->slash, anchored at the root; PSR-4 strips the prefix, PSR-0 keeps the full name path); a use whose leading prefix matches NO composer prefix stays recorded-and-UNRESOLVED (external, the Go module-boundary precedent -- nothing guessed from include_path or runtime autoloading); require/require_once/include/include_once resolve their ONE static string argument (the parser's argument guard: a concatenation like __DIR__ . '/x.php' records NOTHING) relative to the requiring file's directory; the imports relation is a SET; NO mate marking (runtime load order is not a parse fact -- the Rust/Ruby no-mate decision). PSR-4 autoload is resolver CONFIG, not an imports edge. OC005 marking: a use binds its alias or last backslash segment (the class simple name); a require/include binds NULL -- a whole-file claim (the Ruby require discipline). Entry points: NAME conventions only -- index.php (the web entry, a pack bare name that matches the basename at any depth) and **/bin/* runner scripts (the pack glob dialect of the bin/* convention, the Java **/Application.java precedent); the shebang hint does not exist for PHP (a #! line outside PHP blocks is template text and is inert). Test conventions: none registered in v1 (PHPUnit's conventions are not name-pinned in the pack; a *_test.php name claims nothing). OC007 fires only with a Clover XML report (php-code-coverage's clover.xml: <coverage> -> <file name=...> -> <line num= count=>; count > 0 covered; dispatched before the Cobertura reader on the shared <coverage> root; a file entry whose path resolves to no analyzed file lands in the ambiguity meta, never guessed) via --coverage; OC009 only with a vendored OSV snapshot (ecosystem packagist) via --osv-snapshot; OC010 checks the composer.json licence field (the package.json conventions) and skips composer.lock honestly (the lockfile tier is OC009-only). Manifests: composer.json (bounded reader; require/require-dev exact pins are digits-and-dots with optional leading v -- composer constraint ranges ^ ~ > < >= <= * x || - record NOTHING (the npm discipline: a constraint range is not a pin and composer resolves the truth in the lockfile, so no unpinned row is manufactured); platform requirements php/ext-*/lib-*/php-*/composer/hhvm record nothing; autoload prefixes are resolver config; path repos are in-repo links) and composer.lock (packages + packages-dev name+version are the RESOLVED pins). Metaprogramming (variable class names, class_exists gates, runtime autoloading) is not a parse fact -- the Rust macro / Ruby metaprogramming boundary, accepted in the over-report direction for OC006. As-written analysis: declare(strict_types=1) is recorded as nothing. Without their inputs OC007/OC009/OC010 produce nothing and the report meta says so. Passes are pack data, zero tool-code change to flip.

SPRINT-15 adoption, full scope in one sprint (docs/LANGUAGES.md Rust section): all eleven passes enabled. Resolver v1-rust: two declaration-level channels -- the mod-tree (mod name; -> the module file by the stem rule) and the use-tree (crate::/self::/super:: leaves -> the self/crate/super anchors with the item-reading pop ladder; external crate heads stay unresolved, no manifest is ever read). OC003 cycles at file granularity; OC005 marking is by use-leaf binding name (globs fail-open), mod declarations mark nothing (declaring is not using), and there is NO same-directory mate marking (Rust has no same-module mate hole: every cross-file reference goes through a path). Entry points: the pack globs (lib.rs/main.rs) plus the fn main parse fact (claims src/bin/*.rs binaries). Test convention: a .rs file directly inside a tests/ directory is cargo runner data (never OC006 material). OC007 fires only with an LCOV profile passed via --coverage (grcov/cargo-llvm-cov --lcov/cargo-tarpaulin emit it; DA lines are the anchors, covered when the hit count > 0); OC009 only with a vendored OSV snapshot (ecosystem crates.io) via --osv-snapshot; OC010 checks the Cargo.toml licence layering (license / license-file / the project-root licence file). Manifests: Cargo.toml (exact =version requirements are pins; caret/tilde/star/ranges are NOT pins -- unpinned = warn, Cargo's own semantics; path deps are in-repo links, not OC009 material; workspace inheritance resolves within the same manifest only) and Cargo.lock (resolved pins for [[package]] entries with a source field). Trait/extern function signatures are symbols with complexity 1 (the Java discipline); const/static items whose value is a closure are symbols (the item-level named closures); local let-bound closures are never symbols (inclusive counting). cfg attributes are NOT evaluated (the C# #if deliberate keep: both branches stay analyzed, over-report never hides). Without their inputs OC007/OC009/OC010 produce nothing and the report meta says so. Passes are pack data, zero tool-code change to flip.

SPRINT-21 adoption, full scope in one sprint (docs/LANGUAGES.md C++ section): all eleven passes enabled -- the SEVENTH full-scope pack, closing wave-2. The pinned tree-sitter-cpp v0.23.4 grammar (the MAIN org, the same version number as the C pin) inlines the full C grammar at generation time and ships an external scanner (src/scanner.c: raw strings, angle-bracket disambiguation). Symbols: function DEFINITIONS with a body anywhere -- free functions, inline and out-of-class methods, constructors, destructors (the as-written ~X spelling), operator overloads (the as-written operator== spelling), templated functions (template_declaration wraps the definition) -- the name resolved by the declarator-chain walk (the C walk extended: field_identifier members, qualified_identifier name field, destructor_name/operator_name as-written; never guessed). Prototypes and member declarations are NOT symbols (the C discipline; the definition normally exists in the same root). Lambdas are anonymous constructs: NOT symbols, their decisions count inward. Decision table: C's (if_statement with else-if nested, while/do/for, case_statement WITH the value field -- a default arm is the same node WITHOUT it, the gocyclo discipline; the ternary conditional_expression) PLUS for_range_loop (the C++11 range-for is its OWN node type) and catch_clause; && and || inside the shared binary_expression container; preprocessor conditionals are NOT decisions. Resolver v1-cpp: the C include channel SHARED unchanged (quoted -> the including file's directory, angle -> system, never resolves; a macro path records NOTHING; the imports relation is a SET); the using family (using_declaration, alias_declaration, using-directive, namespace aliases) records NOTHING in v1 -- no honest file mapping exists without a manifest, none is invented. NO mate marking (link order is not a parse fact). OC005 marking: an include binds NULL -- a whole-file claim (the Ruby require discipline). Entry points: EMPTY manifest list BY DESIGN -- the entry claim is the PARSE FACT of a free-standing function DEFINITION named main (the Q_CPP_MAIN fact, the Q_C_MAIN query text verified against the cpp grammar by the adoption probe; the identifier-only inner declarator keeps C++ member functions and out-of-class definitions out); entry_points is empty because no basename glob can express 'defines main'. .h ROUTING (the approved C/C++ architecture decision, implemented this sprint): BOTH the c and cpp packs claim .h; a .h file routes through the CONTENT SNIFF (clean cpp parse carrying a C++-distinctive node -> cpp; cpp parse errors with a clean C parse -> c) and otherwise the PROJECT-ROOT DEFAULT (cpp iff the discovered set carries at least one non-.h cpp-pack extension, else c); the counts land in the report meta header_routing block -- never silent; a no-backend build sniffs inconclusive and the root default decides. Until this sprint every .h was C (the documented SPRINT-20 boundary); the C pack's extension list is unchanged. Test conventions: none registered in v1 (no runner-executed C++ convention is name-pinned). OC007 fires with a Cobertura-shaped XML via --coverage; gcovr emits Cobertura XML natively for C++ projects (the same reader as C); lcov tracefiles are out of scope v1. Supply tier (the honest delineation, SPRINT-21): C++ has NO canonical dependency manifest reader in v1 -- OC009 and OC010 are enabled pack data but nothing is ever discovered for them (no fabricated pkg-config/vcpkg/conan tier: a versionless include is not a pin and a vendored tree is not a manifest); without their inputs the passes produce nothing and the report meta says so (manifests_scanned: 0). No OSV ecosystem exists for C++ includes and none is invented. OC010's licence-file probe is a manifest-reader convention and is deferred with the same rationale. Metaprogramming (templates, macros, token pasting) is a parse fact only as far as the grammar sees it -- the Rust macro boundary, accepted in the over-report direction for OC006. As-written analysis: no preprocessing; conditional-compilation variants are reported as the single parsed configuration.
